title: Lane drop, Stop and claim reads use the real lane checkout and live-ship guards
body:
Source: Fable architecture review, report .krn/runs/arch-review/architecture.md (section 5).
Evidence and fixes, each with its regression test:
- src/cli/lane.ts:581 (M9): `krn lane drop` removes the worktree with --force and never checks for a live ship or a process inside it. Fix: reuse the guards in removeFinishedLane.
- src/hook/stop.ts:695-698: when `git worktree add` for the base fails, Stop refuses with "no test is red on the base" and blames the worker. Fix: report an infrastructure error instead.
- src/hook/stop.ts:2080-2092 against 1979-1986 (M3): the stop-loop fingerprint and the refusal file use CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, not the checkout judgeStop resolved. Fix: use the resolved checkout.
- src/hook/stop.ts:1834-1843 (M12): claim files are parsed by hand with no expiry check. Fix: use the claim reader from src/task.
- test/rules/transcript-readers.test.ts:23 (M20): the rule misses five transcript readers in stop.ts. Fix: widen the rule.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts, src/hook/stop.ts, test/hook/stop.test.ts, test/cli/lane.test.ts, test/rules/transcript-readers.test.ts
Outcome: all five fixed with tests (KRN-14).
Proof: the new tests fail on the base and pass on the branch.
